name: Reanu Monogatari ~Wizard of the Darkness Gaiden~
original_name: レアーヌ物語～Wizard of the Darkness外伝～
source:
Leanne is shocked about her sister princess Aria wedding with Garland Empire prince. She is so devastated that she does not notice invasion into Lucana. A magical hand extends right to Leanne princess...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
得知姐姐艾莉娅公主要嫁给加兰德帝国的王子，蕾安娜大受打击。她沉浸在悲伤中，就连卢卡纳遭到入侵也浑然不觉。而魔爪，正向蕾安娜公主伸来……
